# Anurag Gautam — Product Designer & GTM Operator

> Anurag Gautam is a product designer and go-to-market (GTM) operator based in Bengaluru, India. He takes products from zero to in-market — designing the system, building the team, shipping working software, and running the go-to-market — mostly single-handedly. Building since 2017 (a computer-science dropout at 18). He has generated ₹6 Cr+ in B2B revenue, reached 25,000+ users with products he designed, and products he built have raised $2M.

## Who he is

- Name: Anurag Gautam
- Title: Product Designer & GTM Operator
- Location: Bengaluru, India (IST) — works remotely
- Experience: 9 years, building continuously since 2017
- Track record: Marketing agency sales (2017) → Suggaa, ride-hailing — designed the entire design system, rider app, driver app and operator console, built the design team from zero, launched city by city to 25,000+ users (2018–2023) → The PipelineLab, his GTM studio delivering outbound systems and pipeline for B2B teams (2024–present)
- Rare combination: he designs the product, writes and ships the front-end code, produces the content, AND runs the outbound go-to-market. One person covering design × code × GTM.

## What he can be hired for

- Roles (full-time or fractional): Founding Designer, Head of Design, Product Design Lead, GTM / Growth Lead
- Embedded Leadership: part-time or full-time embedded design/marketing/GTM leadership — he plugs in and owns outcomes
- 0→1 Launch Sprint: an idea taken to in-market in ~2–4 weeks, fixed price — product & brand design, real working software (not mockups), launch & content
- GTM retainer (The PipelineLab): scalable B2B outbound systems — ICP, list-building, deliverability, multichannel sequences, compounding pipeline

## Skills

Product & visual design (design systems, app UI, iconography, visual identity) · Motion design (kinetic identity, product motion, launch films) · Content & video (short/long form, shot and edited end to end) · GTM strategy (outbound, ICP, deliverability, pipeline) · Front-end development ("vibe coding" — his portfolio site is designed and coded by him end to end)

## Numbers that matter

- ₹6 Cr+ B2B revenue generated
- 25,000+ users reached by products he designed
- $2M raised by products he built
- 9 years building, no gaps
- Replies to email in ~24 hours
